gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-almarai: Marker-like lines with daylight in every curve: that's Red Hat Display, bold and current. And Almarai takes over where the heading's punch ends, giving a smooth sans whose strokes never swell or pinch shut.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-amarna: Amarna sets the text in strokes with no contrast at all, every small counter left unclogged. And Red Hat Display above it draws its bold, marker-like line with visible daylight inside each curve, so the two feel modern together.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-andika: Confident and contemporary, Red Hat Display draws its heading in a single marker-like line. And Andika handles the quieter work, with tails as thick as its stems and s shapes that turn wide and easy.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-anta:
Red Hat Display's marker-like line stays one width through every curve.

Anta brings wide-mouthed e shapes and a wire-bent look; give it a modest size so the heading's bold line has room to lead.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-antic: Red Hat Display draws bold, marker-like lines with daylight in every curve, which is where it does its best work. Antic follows with a one-nib look and open letter mouths, built for quieter sans text.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-ar-one-sans: Contemporary to the bone, Red Hat Display cuts one single depth throughout, and it earns its keep big and short. AR One Sans follows with brush ends that lift away before each curve closes.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-biz-udgothic: Bold, marker-weight strokes that never change width from stem to curve. BIZ UDGothic keeps a wide channel into every bowl, so long paragraphs would read steadily.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-biz-udpgothic: Flat, bold strokes with no thinning anywhere. Red Hat Display is built to grab attention, while BIZ UDPGothic spreads its letters lavishly and leaves a clear channel into each round shape.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-bpmf-huninn: Bold marker lines, bright inside every curve. Bpmf Huninn has an outline feel at a single weight and wide channels into its bowls, so it can sit at a generous size.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-: Red Hat Display draws everything in one bold marker-like width, with daylight inside every curve. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std softens that with a gentle thick-thin swell, so a longer passage feels easygoing.
